title: NBN POI 4APL (ASPLEY) 4BNB (ASPLEY DEPOT) NNI Rehoming
current_summary: Planned NBN works at the Aspley (4APL) and Aspley Depot (4BNB) POIs in Brisbane have concluded. Services in the area may have experienced brief interruptions between 12:00 AM and 2:00 AM AEST on 11 August 2026 while services were moved to a new router. No further impact is expected.

updates.content: This planned maintenance is now complete. NBN services connected to the Aspley (4APL) and Aspley Depot (4BNB) POIs in Brisbane may have experienced short interruptions between 12:00 AM and 2:00 AM AEST on 11 August 2026 while we moved services to a new router. Services are operating normally and no further impact is expected. We appreciate your patience.
